content.content:
**clearMocks** defaults to `true`. The page says Vitest automatically calls `vi.clearAllMocks()` before each test, which "will clear mock history without affecting mock implementations."

The page does not give defaults for **mockReset** or **restoreMocks**. Their pages are linked in the sidebar, but their content isn't included here.

No version-specific notes appear for clearMocks. The page header shows v5.0.3, but it doesn't say when the default or behavior changed. The page includes one warning: enabling this option "may cause problems with async concurrent tests" because one test's completion can clear mock history used by other tests in progress.

The official Vitest 5.0 migration guide has a section on this change. A Chinese mirror of the official docs is in the results, and it says clearMocks now defaults to true: Vitest calls vi.clearAllMocks() before every test, clearing the recorded history of every mock while leaving implementations intact. I couldn't find the English vitest.dev page directly, so you may want to check it for the canonical wording.

**What changes in practice**

- Call history no longer carries over between tests. The guide's example shows a mock called in one test that asserts a count of 1 there, and in the next test the count starts from zero (v4 would have counted 2).
- Assertions on setup-time calls are the main risk. One third-party write-up notes that tests asserting on mock calls made in setup files, beforeAll hooks, or across multiple tests will now see zero calls and fail.
- The fix is to make the call inside the asserting test, or to set `clearMocks: false` in config.

**Scope of the default**

- One FAQ-style source says the Vitest 5 migration guide changes the default only for clearMocks. mockReset and restoreMocks are not turned on by default.

**Other Vitest 5 requirements**

- Vitest 5.0 requires Vite >= 6.4.0 and Node.js >= 22.12.0.
- Several other changes can also break a first run, including unawaited async assertions now failing and the removal of `sequential`. One summary lists Trigger calls inside the asserting test, or set clearMocks: false as the fix for the clearMocks symptom.

**Note on sources:** The mock-clearing behavior appears consistently across the official mirror and several third-party posts. Some of the third-party pages are blogs and may be less reliable, so verify details against the official changelog and the vitest.dev migration page.

content.text:
It depends on your version. **Vitest 5 clears call history before each test by default. Vitest 4 and earlier do not.**

- **Vitest 5.x:** `clearMocks` defaults to `true`, so `vi.clearAllMocks()` runs before every test. It resets `mock.calls`, `mock.results` and the rest of the call history, but keeps any implementations you set with `mockImplementation` / `mockReturnValue`. `mockReset` and `restoreMocks` are still off by default.
- **Vitest ≤ 4.x:** `clearMocks` defaults to `false`, so call history builds up across tests unless you clear it yourself.

**What breaks when you upgrade to 5:** a test that checks for calls made in setup files, in `beforeAll`, or in an earlier test will now see zero calls. To fix it, either make the call inside the test that checks it, or set it back to the old behavior:

```ts
// vitest.config.ts
export default defineConfig({
  test: { clearMocks: false },
})
```

**Caveat from the docs:** with concurrent async tests, one test finishing can clear the history that another running test still depends on.

Ludion had nothing on this. The current `clearMocks` config page confirms the `true` default. I couldn't open the English migration guide, so the "changed in 5.0" detail comes from the Chinese mirror of the official v5 migration guide and some third-party posts.

Sources:
- [Vitest config: clearMocks](https://vitest.dev/config/clearmocks)
- [Vitest v5 migration guide (CN mirror)](https://v5.cn.vitest.dev/guide/migration/)
- [Vitest 5 changes – OpenReplay](https://blog.openreplay.com/vitest-5-changes/)
- [Vitest 5 migration guide – qaskills](https://qaskills.sh/blog/vitest-5-new-features-migration-guide)
- [releases.sh digest: Mocks clear by default](https://releases.sh/collections/js-toolchain/digest/2026-07-06)
